The main takeaway from our work is that
the collective mass parameterB is not only determined by the particle-particle and particle-hole interaction, but also by the residual interaction of the quasiparticles themselves.
the collective mass-parameter B is not a constant, but a function of the deformation.
the RPA mass parameters are larger than the corresponding quasiparticle ones, which is in contrast to the usual interpretation of the RPA mass parameter in terms of the effective mass.
